authorization: User requested filling the missing evaluations under experiments on 2026-09-27.
scientific_status: Newly specified historical follow-up; original control formulas preserved; expanded evaluation is not an untouched confirmatory test.

reference.score: Arithmetic mean of three native mean-field logits, using exact saved GP covariance; fitted is set before eval.

sequence_controls.alphabet: ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWYX; all other residues map to X
sequence_controls.kmer: Overlapping 3-mer counts, L2 normalized; FP64 accumulation.
sequence_controls.pooled: Raw unstandardized windowed ESM2 150M vectors, original window1022/overlap128/stride894 extractor; L2-normalized FP64 cosine. Identity joins use explicit sequence hashes.
sequence_controls.hash: Original pair_identifier and salt ipin-openppi-pu-r-baseline-v1, seed 20260803; higher hash ranks higher.
sequence_controls.directions: Frozen; no outcome-driven inversion or calibration.

training_graph.graph: Undirected, exact deduplicated train2 positive edges only; no held-out pair evidence.
training_graph.component_mass: Sum train2 positive degrees within each frozen extended sequence component.
training_graph.transfer: Maximum over every train2 positive edge and both endpoint orientations of the minimum endpoint-kernel similarity; no nearest-neighbor shortlist.

alignment.scope: All 17583 frozen sequences against themselves, sequence-only; same search/kernel definitions as the manuscript.
alignment.postfilter: Identity >=20%, E-value <=1e-3 and both aligned spans >=40; exact identity from integer alignment counts.
alignment.symmetry: Maximum accepted kernel value over reported hits in either direction; missing qualifying hits contribute zero.

endpoint_training.architecture: g(z_A)+g(z_B); g affine or width64 GELU MLP; raw windowed ESM2 150M input standardized on all train-partition endpoints only.
endpoint_training.objective: Globally paired P-vs-U softplus; U design weight divided by train-U mean weight.
endpoint_training.order: Canonical numeric unordered-pair order followed by PCG64DXSM(seed+pass) P/U permutations and positive cycling with pass-1 offset.
endpoint_training.checkpoint: Final pass only, no dev/test tuning or checkpoint selection.
endpoint_training.ensemble: Arithmetic mean of three raw unary outputs, summed in FP64; retain exact additive-null cancellation.
endpoint_training.capacity_claim: These retain the historical endpoint-control architectures; they are not capacity-matched TUnA ablations.

primary_evaluation.legacy: Use reconciled version2 labels and weights, preserving exact candidate identities.
primary_evaluation.metric: 0.5*design-weighted P/U concordance in reconciled legacy + 0.5*design-weighted P/U concordance in added cohort.
primary_evaluation.bootstrap: Existing paired extended-component resampling, 2000 deterministic common draws; same component universe and test2 draw IDs as the frozen competitor evaluation.
primary_evaluation.cohort_intervals: Constituent-cohort scores and intervals from the same shared macro component draws.
primary_evaluation.C1_test_sensitivity: Remove every legacy or added C1 development candidate identity; report the complete panel as well.
primary_evaluation.comparisons: selected_31k minus each control, paired on common draws; original eleven primary controls and five additional diagnostic controls are distinguished.
primary_evaluation.intervals: Pointwise 95% percentile intervals, not adjusted for multiple comparisons; conditional on fitted models, frozen corpus and sampled U.

partner_diagnostics.anchor_metric: Equal-anchor mean design-weighted P/U concordance among anchors with at least one P and U partner; equal-cohort macro also reported.
partner_diagnostics.bootstrap: 2000 paired Poisson(1) extended-component draws, seed 20260927 for development and 20260928 for test, shared across both cohorts and all scores; recompute each anchor ratio, give its own component once.
partner_diagnostics.quartets: Both alternative matchings of two P edges with four distinct endpoints; both cross edges must be in the same cohort U panel.
partner_diagnostics.quartet_selection: Ascending salted SHA256, independent of scores; salt expanded-controls-v1:<partition>:C3:<cohort>; max2000 per cohort, max10 uses per positive edge, max50 per endpoint.
partner_diagnostics.quartet_metric: Fraction preferring observed matching from summed native raw scores, half-credit within absolute contrast 1e-6; paired bootstrap weight product over unique endpoint components.
partner_diagnostics.support_policy: Report sparse panels and finite draw counts; withhold inferential conclusions when support floors fail.
partner_diagnostics.interpretation: Candidate-panel partner ranking and selected-quartet preference, conditional on sampled unlabeled alternatives; no direct-binding or population quartet claim.

phase_boundaries.training: Only train2 pairs and sequence-only features mounted; no development/test pairs or labels.
phase_boundaries.scoring: Only candidate identities and frozen scorers mounted; no evaluation labels or weights.
phase_boundaries.evaluation: Test truth mounted only after complete finite predictions are hashed and frozen.
phase_boundaries.test_reuse: Historical test2 already examined; preserve follow-up status.
